text: 你们听从警告，躲到一棵大倒木后。几名男子从西边树林中出现。你认出是原住民猎人，很可能属于图苏蒂纳族；不过，他们的步枪是古董，装备也不如你之前见过的图苏蒂纳人精良。查理提到过一个被放逐的群体——这些猎人会不会就是她说的那些人？

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 581
text: Your party heeds the warning and ducks behind a large fallen tree. Several men emerge from the trees to the west. You recognize Native hunters—probably of the Tsuut’ina; however, their rifles are antique and their gear less sophisticated than the Tsuut’ina you have met before. Charlie said something about an outcast group—could these be the hunters she mentioned?
